tagline: Fastest lap wins. Everything else is negotiable.

scoring._comment: points[0] = 1st place, points[1] = 2nd, etc. Add or remove values to change how many positions score. Anyone finishing outside this list scores 0.

physics._comment: Weight math: every extra weightStepKg over the lightest driver in the field costs penaltySec on a lap. Default here is the classic karting rule of thumb: +10kg = +0.1s/lap. Set refWeightKg to a fixed number (e.g. the kart's minimum ballast weight) instead of null if you'd rather compare everyone to that instead of the lightest driver.
